networks.title: Charge at every network
networks.body: One app for chargers across Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore — live availability, honest prices and a reliability score from real charging sessions.

pay.title: Pay the way you already do
pay.body: QRIS, GoPay, OVO, DANA, PayNow, FPX, GrabPay or card. No top-ups, no sign-up needed to charge.

map.cachedBody: Availability may have changed. Starting a charge needs a connection.
map.emptyBody: Zoom out or move the map to find chargers.

locationPrompt.title: Show chargers near you
locationPrompt.body: {{app}} uses your location only while you use the app, to sort chargers by distance. It is not stored.

locationDenied.title: Location is off
locationDenied.body: Search or move the map to find chargers. You can turn location on in Settings.
